column1: { id: 'zagreus', name: 'Zagreus', epithet: 'The First Blood', fate: 'A son may inherit a kingdom without inheriting its verdict.', ability: 'Blood of the House', description: 'Deal 3 damage to a chosen foe. Every ending sends him back to the fight.', effect: 'strike', power: 3 },

{ id: 'nyx', name: 'Nyx', epithet: 'The Night Made Mother', fate: 'The dark that shelters you is the same dark that hides your enemy.', ability: 'Cloak of Night', description: 'Raise a ward that absorbs 5 damage from the next enemy turn.', effect: 'ward', power: 5 },

{ id: 'thanatos', name: 'Thanatos', epithet: 'The Gentle End', fate: 'Mercy and death can arrive in the same hand.', ability: 'The Debt Collected', description: 'Deal 4 damage and delay the target\'s next attack.', effect: 'bind', power: 4 },

{ id: 'megaera', name: 'Megaera', epithet: 'The First Fury', fate: 'A punishment repeated often enough becomes a habit of the punisher.', ability: 'Whip of the Erinyes', description: 'Deal 4 damage to a chosen foe.', effect: 'strike', power: 4 },
